# Home Mold Water Fire Damage

> Property damage restoration company serving Fort Worth, Haltom City, Bedford, and 20 surrounding Tarrant County, Texas communities with 24/7 emergency water damage restoration, fire and smoke damage restoration, and mold removal and remediation.

Home Mold Water Fire Damage brings 13+ years of restoration experience, trained technicians, and professional drying, dehumidification, and remediation equipment to residential, rental, and commercial properties.

## Core Services

- [Water Damage Restoration Fort Worth (Homepage)](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/): Primary service hub for emergency water extraction, structural drying, dehumidification, and moisture inspection in Fort Worth, TX.
- [Water Damage Restoration Hub](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/water-damage-restoration/): Overview of water removal, burst pipe cleanup, flood extraction, sewage backup cleanup, storm/roof leak damage, carpet/hardwood drying, and structural drying.
- [Fire & Smoke Damage Restoration Hub](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/fire-smoke-damage-restoration/): Emergency board-up, soot cleanup, smoke odor removal, kitchen fire restoration, contents cleaning, and fire sprinkler water damage recovery.
- [Mold Removal & Remediation Hub](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/mold-removal-remediation/): Attic, bathroom, crawlspace, and black mold remediation, mold after water damage, and Texas TDLR-compliant assessment/remediation separation.

## Water Damage Specialties

- [Burst Pipe Cleanup](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/water-damage-restoration/burst-pipe-cleanup.html): Rapid water extraction and structural drying after supply line or pipe failures.
- [Flood Water Extraction](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/water-damage-restoration/flood-water-extraction.html): High-capacity water removal and drying after storm or interior flooding.
- [Sewage Backup Cleanup](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/water-damage-restoration/sewage-backup-cleanup.html): Safe containment, sanitation, and contaminated material removal for sewage backups.
- [Structural Drying & Dehumidification](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/water-damage-restoration/structural-drying-dehumidification.html): Contextual moisture-meter monitoring, air movers, and commercial dehumidifiers.
- [Appliance Leak Water Damage](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/water-damage-restoration/appliance-leak-water-damage.html): Water heater, washing machine, dishwasher, and refrigerator leak mitigation.
- [Storm & Roof Leak Damage](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/water-damage-restoration/storm-roof-leak-damage.html): Interior water removal and ceiling/attic drying following roof intrusion.
- [Basement & Crawlspace Water](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/water-damage-restoration/basement-crawlspace-water.html): Sub-floor and crawlspace extraction and humidity control.
- [Carpet & Hardwood Drying](https://homemoldwaterfiredamage.com/water-damage-restoration/carpet-hardwood-drying.html): Flooring moisture assessment and salvage-focused drying.
